summary: Four intermediate findings; known pending work excluded. Evidence paths are relative to the frozen snapshot; Store abbreviates Sources/DiskStewardCore/EvidenceStore/EvidenceStore.swift and Scanner abbreviates Sources/DiskStewardCore/Monitoring/DirectoryMetadataScanner.swift.

findings.claim: Overlapping traversals can replace a proof while retaining superseded staging. With sorted roots [/R,/R/nested], budget 1, and files a0,a1,nested/A, let nested complete before the ancestor visits it. Delete A. The ancestor's fresh empty pass replaces the proof but leaves staged A, which can publish as present.
findings.recommendation: Bind membership to its producing pass and coordinate overlap ownership. Test this sequence. Do not indiscriminately invalidate every fresh cursor: a subsequently failed root must not erase successful evidence.

findings.claim: Failed-root cleanup can erase successful overlapping-root evidence. Nested stages A and completes; ancestor restages A, overwriting root_path, then fails elsewhere. Cleanup deletes A while nested remains completed with a valid proof.
findings.recommendation: Preserve successful provenance independently of the last root writer. Test ancestor failure after restaging a shared file; nested's successful observation must survive.

findings.claim: Proofs survive publication and ordinary compaction until generation pruning beyond 64 generations. Repeated unchanged scans multiply retained directory rows. Admission occurs before pruning and may block scans before cleanup.
findings.recommendation: Delete transient proofs atomically after publication, or bound and reclaim retention before admission failure. Test repeated unchanged directory-heavy scans with a small cap.

findings.claim: Bounded validation skips already checked directories in the same process. With root/a, root/z and budget 1, validate root and a, delete a/file, then validate z without reopening. Staged a/file can publish. Reopening catches this only because it clears the cursor; acceptance depends on the intended observation interval.
findings.recommendation: Add the same-process counterpart to the reopen test. If intervening observed changes invalidate completion, connect validation to dirty-directory evidence. Otherwise expose the earlier proven interval without implying publication-time membership or an atomic snapshot.
